exact_values_found: JS: n=FMV*r; c=gain*cg; u=FMV-c; f=(FMV-c)*r-c; h=n-f (= c(1+r)). Outputs reproduce. Repo comparators reproduce (my calc: H2 1,513.6 × 3; H3 9,590 × 3; H4 191,156.76). Disclosure omits NIIT.
